_approach: Terror Danjah's Aftershock-era signature: fidgety, jungle-descended percussion and a tight double-snap snare (a main hit plus an immediate quick ghost snap) over an angular, syncopated kick — brasher and more kinetic than the eski-school minimalism, R&B-adjacent in its snap. Ref: XLR8R 'The Devil Inside: Terror Danjah Talks Gremlins, Rhythm'n'Grime, and Nearly Throwing in the Towel'.
